name: sol_token_fe_14
description: Unconditional max-value ERC20 approval breaks on tokens that reject type(uint256).max amounts
question: The source file in `source` calls an ERC20 token's approve (or safeApprove) function with a fixed amount of type(uint256).max for an arbitrary or external token address, without any fallback, try/catch, or alternative lower-amount approval path for tokens that revert on max-value approvals, excluding cases where the token is a known, verified-compliant token or the code already falls back to a smaller approval amount if the max approval fails.
criteria: A function calls token.approve(spender, type(uint256).max) directly on an externally supplied or arbitrary token address with no handling for revert
A helper like universalApprove or safeApproveMax sets the approval amount to type(uint256).max for any token without checking compatibility
Approval logic assumes success of a max-value approve call and proceeds with transferFrom relying on that approval, with no retry using a smaller amount on failure
A vault or router grants max approval to a spender for every listed token in a loop without any token-specific compatibility check or try/catch
